examples.text: Wann geruht denn das Fräulein Tochter aufzustehen?
„S*- Majestät geruhten Sich die öffentlichen Autoritäten und die zahlreich anwesenden Gutsbesitzer vorstellen zu lassen, und nahmen daselbst das Nachtlager.“ (1823)

translations.source_sense_description: spöttisch, ironisch, sonst veraltet: gnädig einem Ansinnen/Wunsch zustimmen

glosses: To condescend; to do despite a perceived affront to one's dignity.

examples.text: He didn’t even deign to give us a nod of the head; he thought us that far beneath him.
My fathers Palace, Madam, vvill be proud / To entertaine your preſence, if youle daine / To make repoſe vvithin.
THE MAJOR-DOMO. Caesar will deign to choose his wine? Sicilian, Lesbian, Chian——
"He will deign to finish this simple fare and wash it down with nothing more Lucullan than beer."
Before I could knock, Bonnie opened the door. “Finally you deign to show up” were the first words said to me. It had been a year.

glosses: To condescend to give; to do something.

examples.text: Nor would we deigne him buriall of his men, / Till he diſburſed, at Saint Colmes ynch, / Ten thouſand Dollars, to our generall vſe.
He, who usually hardly deigned a glance at his infants, now lay gazing with inexpressible softness and sadness at the little sleeping face; […]

O LORD, Jesus Christ, who, before ascending into heaven, didst promise to send the Holy Ghost to finish thy work in the souls of thy Apostles and disciples, deign to grant the same Holy Spirit to me […]

glosses: To esteem worthy; to consider worth notice.

examples.text: Go, go, be gone, to ſaue your Ship from wrack, / Which cannot periſh hauing thee aboarde, / Being deſtin’d to a drier death on ſhore : / I muſt goe ſend ſome better Meſſenger, / I fear my Iulia would not daigne my lines, / Receiuing them from ſuch a worthleſſe poſt.

translations.source_sense_description: spöttisch, ironisch, sonst veraltet: gnädig einem Ansinnen/Wunsch zustimmen

glosses: To express willingness, to give permission.

examples.text: After reflecting a little bit, I've decided to consent to her practising the piano in the house.
My poverty, but not my will, consents.

glosses: To cause to sign a consent form.

examples.text: When the patient was consented to enter the study and registered, a telephone call was made to research assistant

glosses: To grant; to allow; to assent to.

examples.text: Interpreters […] will not consent it to be a true story.

glosses: To agree in opinion or sentiment; to be of the same mind; to accord; to concur.

examples.text: And Saul was consenting unto his death.
Flourishing many years before Wyclif, and much consenting with him in judgment.
All men know by experience, there be some parts of our bodies which often without any consent of ours doe stirre, stand, and lye down againe.

glosses: Unity or agreement of opinion, sentiment, or inclination.

examples.text: And they all with one consent began to make excuse.

translations.source_sense_description: spöttisch, ironisch, sonst veraltet: gnädig einem Ansinnen/Wunsch zustimmen

glosses: книжн., устар., ирон. изъявить желание, милостиво согласиться; соблаговолить (сделать что-либо)

examples.text: — Я буду счастлив, если августейший наш повелитель соизволит одобрить мой поступок.
— Я вам два раза звонила, вы даже не соизволили подойти к телефону.
